Oral mepartricin 40 mg daily is used in the treatment of some prostate disorders. Prostate disorders. Studies1,2 have shown that mepartricin given by mouth is effective in the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (see p.2178 for the more usual treatments); a dose of 40 mg daily is commonly used.2 Mepartricin is thought to reduce cholesterol, oestrogen, and androgen binding to the prostate. Similarly, another study3 has shown that the same dose of mepar- tricin provides symptomatic improvement in the management of chronic prostatitis/chronic pelvic pain syndrome (see Prostatitis, p.2181). 1. Tosto A, et al. A double-blind study of the effects of mepartricin in the treatment of obstruction due to benign prostatic hyperpla- sia. Curr Ther Res 1995; 56: 1270–75. 2. Denis L, et al.
